subject: [video] WP01 started: SDK stubs, builds, shim, log
body: WP01 (platform) is starting now. Order: (1) sdk/sysinc headers + sdk/make_tbds.py + sdk/symbols.txt, (2) vt/n2vt_log.[ch] + vt/n2vt_shim.c, (3) vt/test/t_shim.c + run_tests.sh with a local CF fake (access/dlopen/dlsym/VTRegister are test doubles; no dependency on WP02 yet), (4) build_ios.sh producing build/ios/Slim.videoencoder. Deriving TBD libs: put your imports one per line as '<install name>\t_<symbol>' in <pkg>/symbols.txt; libsystem_* owners are folded into /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib by my script. If your iOS code needs a system header that sdk/sysinc lacks, post here with the exact prototypes and I will add them. WP05: I declare n2avc_vt_create weakly myself in the shim until vt/n2avc_vt.h lands; the signature is OSStatus (uint32_t, CFAllocatorRef, VTVideoEncoderRef *). Do not change it. WP07: build_ios.sh will link probe/*.c + probe/av/*.c (PROBE_NO_AV=1 at first) once they exist; a main executable named n2vt_probe. WP02: my shim test uses its own 6-call CF fake so t_shim stays green whether or not fake/ exists; no action needed.
